entries.speaker: Ryuji

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Sorry, but I'm gonna stay[n]holed up in the bathroom.

entries.speaker: Fellow Teacher
entries.en: Wow, you can really hold your liquor,[n]Yamauchi.

entries.speaker: Yamauchi
entries.en: Mmm, I've had some experience.

entries.speaker: Yamauchi
entries.en: Back in my college days, we'd rent[n]a yacht for the weekend and have[n]massive parties.

entries.speaker: Yamauchi
entries.en: I must say though... the sake's been[n]tasting particularly sweet lately.

entries.speaker: Fellow Teacher
entries.en: No surprise there. Things have been[n]much calmer without Kamoshida.

entries.speaker: Fellow Teacher
entries.en: Those were some real dark times for[n]Shujin though, huh?

entries.speaker: Fellow Teacher
entries.en: But now that he's gone, you finally get[n]the chance you deserve, Yamauchi!

entries.speaker: Yamauchi
entries.en: Don't flatter me, haha.

entries.speaker: Yamauchi
entries.en: He had his strengths, sure... but because[n]of him, our volleyball team will be[n]forever scarred.

entries.speaker: Yamauchi
entries.en: The only real option now is to abandon it[n]completely.

entries.speaker: Yamauchi
entries.en: There has to be a way to bring Shujin[n]back into the limelight though. That's[n]where I come in...

entries.speaker: Fellow Teacher
entries.en: You mean with the track team, right?

entries.speaker: Yamauchi
entries.en: The students who went through so much[n]hardship under Kamoshida rise again[n]with a caring new advisor...

entries.speaker: Yamauchi
entries.en: It'll be the rebirth of a team that found[n]themselves in the depths of despair...[n]The public will love it.

entries.speaker: Yamauchi
entries.en: Despite my lack of track and field[n]knowledge, I'll form a tight bond[n]with the students...

entries.speaker: Yamauchi
entries.en: I'll be the protagonist of my very own[n]tear-jerker...

entries.speaker: Yamauchi
entries.en: And of course all the praise for reviving[n]them will go to me, their incredible,[n]loving advisor.

entries.speaker: Yamauchi
entries.en: I'll have to hire a great coach if I want to[n]pull this off though.

entries.speaker: Fellow Teacher
entries.en: So you're gonna pretend to coach them[n]while someone else does all the legwork?[n]Amazing, Yamauchi!

entries.speaker: Yamauchi
entries.en: Such stunning achievements will[n]look great when it's time to hand[n]out bonuses...

entries.speaker: Yamauchi
entries.en: But I'm not gonna stop there either...[n]I'll publish books, give motivational[n]speeches...

entries.speaker: Fellow Teacher
entries.en: What about all the troublemakers on[n]the team? I've heard that Nakaoka kid[n]is especially bad.

entries.speaker: Yamauchi
entries.en: Nakaoka...? Oh, you mean the one who[n]asked them to bring the pre-Kamoshida[n]coach back?

entries.speaker: Yamauchi
entries.en: Don't worry, I've already taken care[n]of him...

entries.speaker: Yamauchi
entries.en: There's this other boy on the team...[n]Takeishi. Doesn't really excel in much[n]of anything.

entries.speaker: Yamauchi
entries.en: Well, I said I would make him the new[n]captain if he could get rid of that[n]troublemaker Nakaoka.

entries.speaker: Yamauchi
entries.en: I might've mentioned something about[n]how Nakaoka was working with[n]Kamoshida too...

entries.speaker: Yamauchi
entries.en: ...Subtly, of course.

entries.speaker: Fellow Teacher
entries.en: And? What ended up happening?

entries.speaker: Yamauchi
entries.en: Apparently, Takeishi chased him away...[n]The plan worked perfectly!

entries.speaker: Yamauchi
entries.en: And the best part is, not only are[n]Takeishi's parents loaded, but his[n]mother's the president of the PTA.

entries.speaker: Fellow Teacher
entries.en: I see... He'd make a great pawn!

entries.speaker: Yamauchi
entries.en: Perhaps, but a nothing like him[n]could never captain a successful[n]championship-winning team.

entries.speaker: Yamauchi
entries.en: He may have to have an unfortunate[n]"accident" at practice one day.

entries.speaker: Yamauchi
entries.en: But until then, he can show the others[n]the value of obedience.

entries.speaker: Fellow Teacher
entries.en: Hehehe... You're incredible!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That effin' asshole!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If we don't do something quick,[n]Yamauchi's gonna get rid of[n]Takeishi too... Goddammit!
Should we change his heart?
Let's talk to Takeishi.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I really wanna...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But that'd prolly just mess up the track[n]team's comeback... I don't wanna[n]cause 'em more problems.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So... they're just gonna have to decide[n]on their own.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah. This ain't our problem, it's[n]the track team's.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So... they're just gonna have to decide[n]on their own.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Y'know, track ain't a team sport. At least,[n]sprintin' wasn't.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You've got teammates, sure... but you're[n]really just lookin' out for your own time.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That's why I never thought about askin'[n]people for help or tryin' to solve our[n]problems together.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But... I can't ignore the stuff they're[n]goin' through now.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I mean, even though we had our own[n]goals n' shit...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We were still runnin' together.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: They suffered with me, gritted their teeth[n]with me...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Honestly, I think it was only 'cause of[n]them I was able to run at all.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So I can't just go and turn my back on 'em[n]now, right?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I know that ain't the coolest thing to say,[n]but it's how I feel.
I think it's cool, Ryuji.[clr 27]
Wait, what?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...For real? Thanks, man!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Were you sleepin' or something?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I ain't gonna say it again!
I feel like my bond with Ryuji[n]is growing deeper...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Anyways, I'm starvin'! Let's eat some[n]monja while we're here.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So far, all I've seen of this place is[n]the goddamn toilet!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Thanks for hangin' with me, man.
